## Context / Problem
ed2b (`rebar show` intermittently returned EMPTY stdout with exit 0 under concurrent background auto-push) was fixed by bounding the read-path reconverge lock wait (`_RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT = 2` in `src/rebar/_engine_support/reads.py`) and landed with a show-only regression test (`tests/interfaces/store/test_show_no_stall.py`). But read-output integrity under sync contention is a GENERIC property of every read surface that routes through `ensure_fresh` — list, search, ready, next-batch share the same reconverge path as show and would regress silently (bug-trend review change 20: one-time machinery, no bespoke per-surface copies).

## Approach
Generalize the existing ed2b harness rather than inventing a new storm: reuse/hoist `repo_with_origin_tickets` + the `_rebar_cli` helper from `test_show_no_stall.py` into a sibling property module. One property-style test parameterized over the CLI read surfaces (`show`, `list`, `search`, `ready` at minimum): under the same burst-of-writes contention (each `rebar edit` spawning a background push via `REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always`), every ZERO-exit read invocation must produce non-empty, parseable output (JSON where `--output json` exists). A LOUD nonzero exit is acceptable — empty-success is the bug. Explicitly NOT pagination invariants: rebar's read CLI has no cursor/offset pagination; the property is output-integrity-or-loud-error.

## Scope
- tests/interfaces/store/ — new sibling module + minimal fixture/helper hoist (no production code)

## Testing
The test IS the deliverable. RED demonstration: temporarily revert the ed2b ledge locally (raise `_RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT` back to the 15s writer default so reads stall on the held lock) and observe the property fail on at least one surface; restore and confirm green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] One parameterized property covers show/list/search/ready via the real CLI under the ed2b write-burst + background-push harness; no bespoke per-surface copies.
- [ ] Invariant pinned: exit 0 implies non-empty parseable output; nonzero exits pass (loud failure allowed).
- [ ] RED demonstrated by locally reverting the reads.py lock-timeout ledge; green on the fixed tree.
- [ ] ed2b harness reused (hoisted or imported), not duplicated.
